description: This file defines a 'Quirks' extension for the Notesnook editor, handling custom keyboard shortcuts and node behaviors such as backspace handling and node escaping at document start.

classes.name: Quirks
classes.description: An extension that manages editor quirks like backspace behavior and node escaping.
